prompts.task: Audit the Go chi service in ./service for OpenTelemetry coverage. Do not modify application code or configuration. Write canonical ./service/.observe/otel-audit.json, render the self-contained ./service/.observe/otel.html, and retain ./service/.observe/otel.md for compatibility. Validate the JSON, then run the bundled observe_report.py gate against .observe/otel-audit.json with --fail-on required as a headless CI/MR policy check. Report exit 1 as an invalid artifact/tool error and exit 2 as an explicit unresolved-required-finding policy match; do not claim that an external CI system was configured.

judge_inputs: Read ./last_message.md for the agent final response.
rubric: Writes valid schema-v2 .observe/otel-audit.json with authored otel_concerns, verification references, and complete downstream instrumentation context plus a self-contained, decision-first .observe/otel.html showing compact signal-type shape, conditional prerequisite IDs, configuration scope beside exact telemetry, and collapsed acceptance checks, implementation guardrails, and evidence without changing application code or configuration; .observe/otel.md remains a compatibility artifact, and the HTML omits per-card raw scenario IDs and OTel taxonomy and does not duplicate the canonical flow as a component/service map or raw flow view.
Identifies main.go as the process entrypoint and enumerates GET /health, GET /tasks, GET /tasks/{id}, POST /tasks, PATCH /tasks/{id}, and DELETE /tasks/{id}.
Reports that no OpenTelemetry SDK, provider, exporter, or instrumentation is currently configured.
Provides stable finding IDs and verification-scenario references suitable for selected-ID otel-instrument and otel-verify handoff.

Runs the headless observe_report.py gate against .observe/otel-audit.json with --fail-on required, distinguishes exit 1 validation/tool failure from exit 2 policy match, and does not claim to install or invoke an external CI agent.
